# `analysis_cache/` — the intermediate results of the measurements

**Not tracked.** Around 31 MB. Everything in here is regenerated by rerunning the script that
produced it: it is cache, not data. Deleting it costs CPU time and nothing else.

The distinction from [`../reports/`](../reports/), which *is* tracked, is sharp: here live the
**raw** measurements, one row per configuration tried; there live the final tables, the ones the
documents in `.claude/docs/` quote. `scripts/sweep_report.py` is the step between the two.

## What it holds

| what | produced by | what it keeps |
|---|---|---|
| `sweeps/` (342 files, 10 MB) | `scripts/strategy_sweep.py` | every configuration of every strategy, per symbol/interval/commission |
| `lab/` (4.1 MB) | `scripts/strategy_lab.py` | the same for the two-sided strategies |
| `confluence_audit/` (9.1 MB) | `scripts/confluence_audit.py` | the same configurations over many assets, in and out of sample |
| `ai_voter/` (7.8 MB) | `scripts/ai_voter.py` | the voter trained on the confluence's trades |
| loose `*.parquet` | `scripts/analysis.py` | the individual measurements of `strategy.md`: `break_even`, `cusum_rates`, `concurrency`, `market_regimes`, `pivot_delays`, `random_walk`, `time_to_target`, `barrier_capacity`, `capture_sweep`, `operating_points`, `store_coverage` |

The sweep filenames carry the measurement's parameters
(`atr_bands_15m_BTCUSDT_2021_fee005.parquet`, with `_annuale` for the year-by-year view): that is how
you know what you are looking at without opening it.
